description: Partner program pages — for distributors, service centers, and regional partners

partner_types.title: Become an Industrial Parts Distributor
partner_types.target_audience: Companies already distributing industrial equipment, spare parts, or MRO supplies in their local market. Looking to add Chinese-manufactured industrial components to their product portfolio.
value_proposition: Direct factory pricing without intermediary markups
Access to 8 industrial system categories from verified manufacturers
Technical documentation and quality certificates provided
requirements: Registered business entity in target market
Existing customer base in industrial sectors
onboarding_process: Submit distributor application with company profile
Market and territory assessment by HISVIA
First container order and market launch

revenue_sources: Wholesale pricing from factory with distributor margin
Volume-based tier pricing for larger commitments
Exclusive territory premium for committed partners
business_model.investment_required: Minimum annual purchase commitment (amount negotiated per territory)
business_model.note: Specific margins and commitments are negotiated individually. HISVIA does not publish fixed rates as they vary by product category and territory.

partner_types.title: Authorized Service & Repair Center
partner_types.target_audience: Industrial equipment repair workshops, maintenance service providers, and technical service companies that repair and maintain industrial machinery for end users.
value_proposition: Direct source for replacement parts and repair kits
Technical service bulletins and repair manuals
Priority parts supply for urgent repairs
Brand-neutral service capability for multi-brand fleets
Referral of local buyers from HISVIA platform
requirements: Workshop with repair and testing capability
onboarding_process: Submit service center application with capability description
Parts catalog and pricing access setup

revenue_sources: Service revenue from equipment repair and maintenance
Parts markup on replacement components supplied
Referral commission from HISVIA for buyer introductions
business_model.investment_required: Initial parts stock order (amount based on service scope)
support_provided: Priority parts supply for urgent repairs
Listing on HISVIA partner network for local buyer referrals

partner_types.title: Regional Market Representative
partner_types.target_audience: Individuals or companies with strong local networks in industrial sectors. Act as HISVIA's local representative to connect buyers with Chinese supply chain capabilities.
value_proposition: Full technical and commercial support from HISVIA
Market exclusivity options for committed agents
Access to supplier factory visits and training
requirements: Local market knowledge and industrial network
onboarding_process: Submit agent application with market experience
Marketing materials and buyer introduction process

revenue_sources: Project-based fees for large procurement programs
Market development incentives for new territory growth
business_model.investment_required: No inventory investment. Time investment in market development.
support_provided: Full supplier matching and technical support
